rationale: The intelligence engine delegates prediction to the Phase 6 prediction
package rather than copying model binaries, so there is exactly one
validated model and one source of truth. Validation evidence:
series-grouped out-of-fold evaluation; grouped-OOF balanced accuracy
0.530 vs 0.333 majority baseline, every fold above baseline.
usage: POST /predict on the intelligence API delegates to prediction.predict.predict_outcome
caveats: predicts the recorded outcome label, not physical combustion behaviour
burning-rate column is not a feature (unit unresolved)
group-aware evaluation used; experimental independence remains unestablished
